moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festivals return
moments.blurb: The twin Reading and Leeds Festivals are set to take over Richfield Avenue and Bramham Park from August 27-30, 2026, featuring a massive lineup of rock, indie, pop, and hip-hop acts.

angles.name: Festival Buzz
angles.copy: Who are you buzzing to see at Reading & Leeds next week? The countdown is ON! #RandL26

angles.name: Lineup Drop
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds Festivals are just days away! Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine, Skepta and loads more are heading to Richfield Avenue and Bramham Park. What's your must-see set?

moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 season kicks off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season begins this Friday, August 21, with defending champions Arsenal hosting newly promoted Coventry City in the opening match.

angles.name: Kick-off Excitement
angles.copy: The Premier League is back this Friday! Who's ready for Arsenal vs Coventry City to kick off the new season?

angles.name: Weekend Fixtures
angles.copy: Hull vs Man Utd, Newcastle vs Liverpool, Fulham vs Chelsea... the Premier League fixtures are looking spicy this weekend! Which game are you most looking forward to?

moments.title: Madonna's 68th birthday
moments.blurb: The iconic Queen of Pop, Madonna, would have celebrated her 68th birthday yesterday, August 16, having been born in 1958.

angles.name: Queen of Pop
angles.copy: Yesterday, we celebrated the 68th birthday of the one and only Queen of Pop, Madonna! Which of her iconic tracks is your all-time favourite?

angles.name: Madonna's Influence
angles.copy: Still influencing pop culture decades later. Happy (belated) 68th to Madonna, a true legend! What's her most groundbreaking moment for you?

moments.title: Demi Lovato turns 34
moments.blurb: American singer, songwriter, and actress Demi Lovato, known for hits like 'Skyscraper' and 'Sorry Not Sorry', celebrates their 34th birthday on August 20, 2026.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Demi
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 34th Birthday to the incredible Demi Lovato this Thursday! What's your favourite Demi track?

angles.name: Demi's Journey
angles.copy: From Disney star to pop powerhouse, Demi Lovato turns 34 on August 20th. Celebrate their journey with us!

moments.title: Dua Lipa turns 31
moments.blurb: British-Albanian pop sensation Dua Lipa, celebrated for global hits like 'New Rules' and 'Levitating', will celebrate her 31st birthday on August 22, 2026.

angles.name: Birthday Shoutout
angles.copy: Get ready to dance! Dua Lipa turns 31 this Saturday, August 22nd. Which of her tracks gets you on the floor?

angles.name: Future Nostalgia
angles.copy: Happy almost birthday to Dua Lipa! The 'Future Nostalgia' star celebrates her 31st this weekend. What's your favourite album of hers?

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold UK No.1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' remains at number one on the UK Singles Chart for the week ending August 19, 2026, marking its 21st non-consecutive week at the top and becoming the longest-running UK number-one single of all time.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Still at number one! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' makes history with its 21st week at the top of the UK Singles Chart! Have you streamed it today?

angles.name: New Chart Entries
angles.copy: Also new in the Top 10: Madonna & Kylie Minogue with 'Love Sensation' at #8! What else is in your weekend playlist from the latest chart?

moments.title: Remembering Liam Payne
moments.blurb: Liam Payne, a beloved member of One Direction, would have been 33 years old on August 29, 2026. He tragically passed away in October 2024.

angles.name: Tribute to Liam
angles.copy: Remembering Liam Payne, who would have celebrated his 33rd birthday on August 29th. His music continues to resonate with so many.

angles.name: Liam's Legacy
angles.copy: On August 29th, we remember the talent of Liam Payne, who would have been 33. His contribution to music lives on.
